description: This file provides a web interface for resetting or restoring a network gateway device, including options to reset the device, restart Wi-Fi modules, restore factory settings, and reset passwords. It includes server-side PHP includes and client-side JavaScript for user interactions.

methods.name: setResetInfo
methods.description: Prepares and executes an AJAX request to reset or restore the gateway based on user interaction, handling reboot, Wi-Fi restart, and other reset actions.

methods.name: checkForRebooting
methods.description: Checks if the device has rebooted by polling the index.php page, redirects to login page upon success.
